title: Computational Social Science and Critical Studies of Education and Technology: An Improbable Combination?

bias_targets.methodology: Using Natural Language Processing (a fine-tuned BERT model) to analyze over 800,000 online K-12 school reviews and correlating specific phrases with the racial demographics of the schools, as well as developing machine-informed redistricting algorithms to mitigate racial segregation.

Applying NLP to school reviews to correlate review language with census-derived socioeconomic status and the percentage of students receiving free or reduced lunch, alongside evaluating participatory algorithms for equitable school rezoning to address income-based segregation.
